decisions.reason: The source explicitly preserves the established Hero V slope, structure, and geometry; only the separately owned shared terminal treatment changes.
The terminal refinement applies only to the Hero V, second V, and É accent, not to the remaining proprietary letterforms.
The second V retains its established geometry, construction, hierarchy, and supporting role; the changed terminal character is owned by the shared terminal-treatment Requirement.
The requested precision, confidence, restraint, and quiet elevation are consistent with the existing brand expression and do not replace or narrow its current attributes.
The same message's Balanced Flow kerning selection is already represented; the terminal refinement does not change the wordmark's spacing, baseline, scale, or composition hierarchy.
Requesting terminal studies before further material work does not change the selected Satin Reflection preference, distribution, or champagne-gold treatment attributes.

The É accent remains a literal derivative of the Hero V terminal with the same copy and alignment rules; the new shared terminal character is owned by the source Requirement and leaves those derivation rules unchanged.
The terminal refinement does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
